jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

We are looking for a seasoned operations leader to run the financial and workforce operating engine for Okta's Product & Technology organization — a 2,000+ person R&D function spanning the Okta Platform (ORD) and Auth0. The team is accountable for the budget and workforce strategy components of the R&D Operating Plan, program spend and budget governance, financial compliance including Capitalized Software and R&D tax credit capture, vendor operations, and headcount governance in partnership with Recruiting. The team also runs the annual goal-setting process and the operating cadence that tracks R&D performance against those goals. This is a role that demands real depth in engineering finance operations alongside the organizational judgment to translate executive strategy into a defensible budget and a credible hiring plan.

This role sits within Okta's R&D ("ORD") organization, reporting to the Head of Strategy & Operations and Chief of Staff to the President of Okta R&D. This role is hub-based: it sits in San Francisco, Seattle or Chicago, and candidates must live within commutable distance of one of those offices. We expect this leader to work from the office multiple days each week.

Job Duties / What This Role Entails

• Own the budget and workforce strategy components of the R&D Operating Plan, translating corporate strategy and the long-range plan into a fully resourced annual plan across ORD and Auth0.

• Direct R&D budget governance for a 2,000+ person organization — program spend oversight, variance reporting, fiscal discipline, and executive-level budget reviews with the President of Okta R&D and Finance leadership.

• Own and evolve the P&L framework for R&D lines of business, arming executive leadership with the cost and investment data behind portfolio decisions.

• Model, govern and optimize AI token spend across the P&T organization — establish the cost baseline and forecasting model, build the framework for measuring return on that spend, and partner with engineering leaders to drive efficiency as consumption scales.

• Lead engineering cost modeling, and partner with FP&A and Deal Desk on account-specific margin analysis to support pricing, packaging and large-deal decisions.

• Own financial compliance for R&D, including Capitalized Software entries and maximizing US/Canada R&D tax credit capture.

• Build and own the P&T expense data platform on Snowflake to enable clean line-of-business cost distribution and self-service cost visibility for engineering leaders.

• Set the fiscal year workforce strategy in partnership with Recruiting leadership — headcount governance, real-time allocation tracking, backfills, organizational growth mapping, and location strategy.

• Own the contingent workforce program end to end, including contractor and agency lifecycle, capacity and spend.

• Own vendor operations for R&D — third-party relationships, capacity management, contract renewals, and performance SLAs.

• Continuously refine the financial and workforce operating processes to eliminate friction and ensure the organization scales efficiently as it grows.

• Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to develop the fiscal year goals and OKRs for the R&D organization, and run the program cadence — monthly and quarterly reviews — that gauges performance against them.

• Set the standard for AI-first operations — apply AI to financial analysis, dashboard generation and workflow automation, and build a team for which AI fluency is core to how the work gets done rather than an experiment on the side.

• Build, mentor and develop the operations team as a source of durable advantage for Okta R&D, including hiring and developing Director-level leaders.

This is a team leadership role with five direct reports.

Qualifications / Who You Are (Must Have)

• 12+ years of work experience, including 6+ years leading business operations, R&D / engineering operations, or FP&A functions within a technology company.

• Demonstrated ownership of an engineering or R&D budget at scale — annual planning, in-year governance, variance management, and executive budget review.

• Proven ownership of workforce planning and headcount governance in close partnership with Recruiting and Finance.

• Experience managing a vendor portfolio, including contract negotiation and renewal, SLA management, and capacity planning.

• Hands-on experience with Capitalized Software accounting and R&D tax credit programs in the US and/or Canada.

• Strong understanding of B2B SaaS business models and engineering cost structures.

• Track record of building and developing high-performing operations teams, including hiring and developing Director-level leaders.

• Extensive experience navigating complex data sets and operating with ambiguity, where clean data is not available.

• Demonstrated use of AI to do the substance of finance and operations work — analysis, reporting, dashboard generation and workflow automation — with a clear point of view on where to apply it next.

Qualifications / Who You Are (Good to Have)

• Experience operating across multiple product units or post-acquisition entities with distinct financial and operational systems.

• Familiarity with Snowflake, or comparable experience building financial data platforms and self-service reporting.

• Experience modeling or governing consumption-based spend, such as cloud infrastructure or AI / LLM token usage.

• Experience with global workforce and location strategy, including India-based engineering centers.

• Understanding of the B2B enterprise technology space, specifically Enterprise Security.

• Experience running an annual goal-setting or OKR process for a technology organization, including the review cadence that tracks progress against it.

• Prior experience in FP&A, management consulting, or a central strategy and operations function.

• MBA, or an undergraduate degree with a concentration in Finance, Economics, Statistics or Engineering.

Why this role?

• Own the full financial and workforce operating infrastructure for a 2,000+ person R&D organization at a category-defining security company.

• Rare breadth of charter: FinOps, workforce operations and vendor operations, across an at scale SaaS R&D organization.

• A genuinely new problem to own: defining how a 2,000+ person R&D organization budgets for, measures the return on, and optimizes its AI spend.

• Direct line of sight into executive decision making — your models and plans are the basis on which R&D investment is allocated.

• High degree of autonomy to shape the R&D operating model rather than inherit it.

• Strong executive sponsorship from Okta's product and engineering leadership team.

Additional requirements:

• There is no citizenship requirement. The Okta employee must be on US Soil, which means the 50 states, the District of Columbia, or outlying areas of the United States, as defined in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 2.101

About the Team
The Applied Engineering team works across research, engineering, product, and design to bring OpenAI’s technology to consumers and businesses.
You’ll join the team responsible for running the core infrastructure that supports products like ChatGPT and the API. The systems we support include our kubernetes clusters, infrastructure deployment, our networking stack, cloud abstractions, and more.
We seek to learn from deployment and distribute the benefits of AI, while ensuring that this powerful tool is used responsibly and safely. Safety is more important to us than unfettered growth.
About the Role
The cloud infrastructure team builds and maintains infrastructure abstractions allowing OpenAI to ship products quickly and scalably.
This role is based in San Francisco, CA.
In this role, you will:
• Design and build the development and production platforms that power our products, enabling reliability and security at scale

• Ensure our infrastructure can scale to the next order of magnitude

• Help create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture that makes all feel welcome while enabling radical candor and the challenging of group think

• Like all other teams, we are responsible for the reliability of the systems we build. This includes an on-call rotation to respond to critical incidents as needed.

You might thrive in this role if you:
• Have 5+ years building core infrastructure

• Have experience operating orchestration systems such as Kubernetes at scale

• Have experience building abstractions over cloud platforms

• Take pride in building and operating scalable, reliable, secure systems

• Are comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change

This role is exclusively based in our San Francisco HQ. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Ramp is building an AI-native platform that changes how Go-to-Market and Product Growth teams create, launch, and improve customer-facing experiences. We are looking for a product-minded backend engineer to help build the infrastructure and services that power modern growth and marketing at Ramp.
The next chapter for this team is to build marketing-led products : intelligent tools that turn strategy into execution, automate complex workflows, and help teams operate across channels with dramatically more leverage.
The team will build across creative production, lifecycle marketing, paid media, account-based marketing, experimentation, incentives, and cross-channel orchestration. Examples include AI-powered systems that produce on-brand campaign assets, automate complex marketing workflows, coordinate audiences and execution, and deliver personalized experiences across email, sales outreach, external channels, and Ramp’s product.
A core part of this mandate is Ramp’s incentives platform. We are building shared infrastructure to safely target, authorize, distribute, redeem, and measure incentives across channels and mediums—including in-app experiences tied to product adoption and growth goals. This requires combining marketer-friendly workflows with governed policies, budget controls, reliable financial operations, and closed-loop measurement.
You will work at the intersection of product engineering, AI, data, marketing, and financial infrastructure. The ideal candidate is a product-minded backend engineer who can translate ambiguous workflows into durable systems. You will build the data models, APIs, integrations, and orchestration capabilities that allow marketers, product teams, and AI agents to safely execute complex work end to end.

What You’ll Do
• Build the backend systems that power AI-native marketing and growth products across creative production, experimentation, incentives, and cross-channel orchestration.

• Build shared incentives infrastructure for eligibility, targeting, policies, budgets, authorization, issuance, redemption, and outcome tracking.

• Enable personalized content and offers across email, sales workflows, external channels, and in-product experiences using shared customer and campaign context.

• Design reliable orchestration for long-running work, approvals, scheduling, retries, human intervention, and safe AI or financial execution.

• Connect marketing actions and incentive spend to measurable activation, conversion, retention, and revenue outcomes.

• Partner across Marketing, Product Growth, Product, Data Science, Finance, and GTM Platform to own systems from early discovery through production adoption and iteration.

What You Need
• 5+ years of software engineering experience building production backend systems, with strong proficiency in Python or another modern server-side language.

• A track record of owning production services, APIs, data models, and distributed or event-driven workflows.

• Strong product judgment and system-design fundamentals, including data modeling, asynchronous processing, reliability, testing, and observability.

• Experience building governed systems involving permissions, policies, budgets, balances, entitlements, or financial actions.

• Experience applying AI to real product workflows—or strong interest in doing so—with an understanding of where deterministic controls and human approval are required.

• Excellent cross-functional communication and a bias toward rapidly shipping measurable user and business outcomes.

Nice to Haves
• Experience building incentive, rewards, promotion, loyalty, payments, ledger, or financial-authorization systems.

• Experience building workflow engines, automation platforms, agent systems, or orchestration infrastructure.

• Experience with lifecycle marketing, product growth, paid media, experimentation, CRM, or other marketing technology.

• Experience designing human-in-the-loop AI systems, including approvals, evaluations, tool execution, and recovery.

• Experience with customer-data platforms, identity systems, behavioral event streams, or analytical data infrastructure.

• Experience building experimentation or attribution systems that connect interventions to customer and business outcomes.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

• Atlanta, US

• Austin, US

• Denver, US

• New York, US

Applications will be accepted until November 01, 2026.

Role summary

In this role, you will focus on the buildout and expansion of our global network infrastructure across 700+ datacenter locations. You will work closely with Cloudflare’s Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, Network Engineering team, and various global partners—including hardware vendors, datacenter providers, and ISPs—to aggressively scale and maintain our physical footprint. This is a highly visible position requiring a strong blend of physical networking knowledge, datacenter infrastructure expertise, basic data analysis, and proactive project coordination.

Role Responsibilities

• Provisioning & Deployment: Provision, configure, monitor, and maintain physical hardware, networking devices, and software in both greenfield deployments and brownfield migrations.

• Remote Datacenter Operations: Perform server administration remotely using IPMI/BMC out-of-band management tools for server provisioning, troubleshooting, and firmware updates.

• Automation & AI Workflows: Build scripts using Python and other tools to eliminate repetitive toil. Actively leverage and develop agentic AI tools to reduce administrative overhead.

• Vendor & Contractor Management: Direct remote hands and field contractors on rack-and-stack installations, optical cross-connects, cable management, power (AC/DC), and cooling requirements.

• Technical Guidance: Provide technical leadership to remote contractors and junior team members during on-site deployments, walking them through configurations and quality control.

• Documentation & Process Improvement: Create and maintain standardized SOPs, MOPs, runbooks, and visibility metrics to ensure operational consistency across all global regions.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Infrastructure Planning, SRE, and Network Engineering teams on global expansion projects. Limited travel required.

Role Requirements

Must-Have Skills

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in Data Center Operations, Network Engineering, Linux System Administration, SRE, or DevOps.

• Datacenter Infrastructure: In-depth knowledge of physical power/cooling, optics (CWDM/DWDM), cable standards, and remote "lights-out" management (IPMI/BMC).

• Networking Foundations: Strong grasp of network protocols, topologies, and design, with experience troubleshooting physical and logical network connectivity.

• Automation & Tooling: Proficient in writing Python or Bash scripts to automate operational tasks. Experience using or building agentic AI tools for workflow efficiency is required.

• Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with tools such as SaltStack, Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.

• Operational Drive: Proven capability to manage global vendors, anticipate blockers before execution, spot failure patterns, and write precise MOPs/SOPs.

Nice-To-Have Skills

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, MIS, or equivalent practical experience.

• Familiarity with network NOS platforms: Juniper Junos, Cisco IOS/NX-OS, Arista EOS, SONiC, Ciena, or Nokia/Infinera.

• Core internet routing knowledge (BGP, Anycast) and load balancing concepts (Nginx, HAProxy).

• Basic program management experience using JIRA, Excel, or Google Sheets to track multi-region rollouts.

• Multi-lingual capabilities and experience managing infrastructure across diverse international regions.

• Linux certifications (RHCSA/RHCE) or programming experience in Go.

Bonus Points

• Professional level network certification(s) (JNCIP, CCNP, etc) or higher.

• Linux certifications. Experience with continuous / rapid deployment.

• Experience working in a 24/7/365 mission-critical service environment (on-call rotation required)

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Data represents the voice of Airbnb’s users at scale. The Data Warehouse Infrastructure team is responsible for the foundational big data infrastructure, which is used by hundreds of engineers to collect, manage, and analyze data at scale. We are using open source technologies like Hadoop, Spark, Trino, Iceberg, Airflow etc.

A Typical Day:

• Design and build the next generation big data compute platform to empower data ETL, analytics and machine learning at Airbnb

• Operate, manage and improve the reliability, performance, observability and cost efficiency of the platform.

• Write maintainable and self-documenting code, perform code reviews.

• Work on, and contribute to open source software, and have industry impact.

Your Expertise:

• BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience preferred.

• 10+ years of experience working with data infrastructure, with a focus on big data technologies.

• Proficiency in big data technologies such as Spark, Presto/ Trino, Kubernates.

• Strong programming skills in languages such as Java, Scala.

• Extensive experience in designing, building, and maintaining scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems.

• Demonstrated expertise in multi-threading and concurrency programming.

• Familiar with database systems, both SQL and NoSQL.

• Proven ability to collaborate with other teams to define system requirements, identify potential solutions, and test and integrate systems.

• Capacity to troubleshoot and resolve complex data infrastructure problems.

• Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity :

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.
How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. $212,000 — $265,000 USD

We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Engineering Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join Okta's Emerging Products Group (EPG). Our mission is to build highly reliable, scalable, and secure cloud services that our customers can trust. We embrace an automation-first mindset and continuously invest in platform engineering, observability, and operational excellence to enable our engineering teams to move quickly and safely.

This role is ideal for an experienced Site Reliability Engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges at scale, building automation, and improving the reliability of production systems. You will serve as a key contributor within the EPG SRE organization, partnering closely with software engineers, architects, and product teams to design, build, and operate world-class cloud services.

What You'll Be Doing

Reliability & Operations

• Design, build, and operate large-scale cloud infrastructure and production services.

• Participate in an on-call rotation supporting highly available customer-facing systems.

• Lead incident response efforts and drive post-incident reviews focused on systemic improvements.

• Define, measure, and improve Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and error budgets.

• Partner with engineering teams to improve service availability, scalability, performance, and resilience.

• Continuously improve observability through metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerting.

Engineering & Automation

• Develop software, automation, and infrastructure using Go, Python, Terraform, and related technologies.

• Eliminate operational toil through automation, tooling, and platform engineering.

• Improve deployment safety and operational workflows through CI/CD and GitOps practices.

• Collaborate on modernizing existing workloads and aligning them with evolving platform capabilities.

• Build self-service platforms, operational guardrails, and automation that improve developer velocity while maintaining reliability and security.

What We Are Looking For

Technical Excellence

• Strong experience operating large-scale production services in AWS and/or GCP.

• Deep expertise with Kubernetes in production environments.

• Experience troubleshooting Kubernetes networking, storage, scheduling, scaling, and workload lifecycle issues.

• Extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform and Helm.

• Strong software engineering skills in Golang and/or Python.

• Experience building automation and internal engineering platforms.

• Experience operating and troubleshooting distributed data platforms such as PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenSearch, MySQL, Cassandra, or similar technologies.

• Strong understanding of cloud networking fundamentals including DNS, load balancing, ingress, TLS, service networking, and traffic management.

• Experience with observability platforms, monitoring strategies, and production telemetry.

• Experience with or strong interest in AI-assisted engineering and operational automation.

Operational Excellence

• Strong expertise operating customer-facing production systems.

• Experience leading incident response and driving operational improvements.

• Deep understanding of reliability engineering concepts including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and capacity planning.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, and automation-first operational practices.

• Proven ability to balance reliability, scalability, security, and engineering velocity.

jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

Senior Product Manager, Money Movement Experiences

Menlo Park, CA

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you're ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Money Movement team builds the products that let customers move money and assets into, out of, and within Robinhood. Our work spans the infrastructure and partner integrations underneath and the experiences customers see on top, and we partner closely with design, data science, compliance, and fraud. Moving money is where customers decide whether they trust a product, and we want it to feel as good as investing.

We care a lot about removing friction. A transfer should be fast and easy to follow, with the kind of polish customers notice. Everything else customers do at Robinhood starts here, so we want it to be something they enjoy.

As a Senior Product Manager on the customer experience side of Money Movement, you will set the vision for how moving money feels and deliver experiences customers find clear and delightful. You will lead zero-to-one launches, own the end-to-end journey across mobile and web, and sweat the details, from the copy and motion to the states in between. You will partner with design, engineering, legal, and operations to ensure what we ship is compliant and a pleasure to use.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

• Define the long-term product vision and roadmap for Robinhood's money movement customer experience, spanning funding, deposits, withdrawals, and transfers

• Lead zero-to-one product initiatives that make moving money faster and more delightful, from first concept through launch

• Partner closely with design to shape the work, give and receive sharp critique, and hold a high bar for craft and interaction detail

• Drive significant improvements in funnel conversion, transaction success, and customer satisfaction by finding friction and failure points in the journey and using research, experimentation, and analytics to prioritize

• Partner with engineering and the platform teams that own our payment rails and vendor integrations to turn platform capabilities into reliable, fast customer-facing experiences

• Work with compliance, legal, and fraud teams to ensure every experience meets regulatory requirements without compromising the customer experience

What you bring

• Bachelor's, Master's, or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of experience in a product management role, with a proven track record of shipping consumer products that customers love, ideally mobile-first

• A history of close collaboration with design: you partner with designers from concept to launch, give and receive sharp critique, and hold a high bar for craft

• Exceptional attention to detail and strong product taste, with examples of experiences you shaped where polish made a measurable difference

• Experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated consumer space is a plus; you do not need to be a payments expert, and you will learn the rest quickly

• High technical empathy and experience partnering closely with engineering to resolve complex tradeoffs and deliver clean user experiences

• Familiarity using user research, experimentation, and product analytics to guide decision making

• Demonstrated ability to navigate extreme ambiguity, formulate opinionated product recommendations, and drive alignment across senior stakeholders

• A strong sense of urgency and speed, high standards, and a strong work ethic: you always bring your best and expect your colleagues to do the same

• Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with design, engineering, operations, and external partners

What we offer

• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.

• Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.

• Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.

• Lifestyle wallet: a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.

• Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.

• Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

• Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Base Pay Range:

Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC)
$166,000 — $195,000 USD

Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL)
$146,000 — $172,000 USD

Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL)
$129,000 — $152,000 USD

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.
